notes: I found no NovaSeq or Illumina award data from GeBIZ. The GeBIZ home page (opened) has a public search box for current opportunities. It shows no awarded-tender listings and gives no sign that they can be read without a Singpass/CorpPass/GeBIZ ID login. Search snippets returned only EU and UK notices, with no Singapore hits. The data.gov.sg dataset 'Government Procurement via GeBIZ' (seen only in a search snippet) holds award data. Its fields are tender number, description, agency, award date, supplier and awarded amount. It has about 18.6K rows covering roughly Mar 2019 to Mar 2024, so it misses 2025-26 and the X-era shift. Tender descriptions are short, and awards are lump sums, so they won't separate 6000 from X kits or give a price per kit. I did not open the CSV, so whether any Illumina rows exist is unconfirmed. The only incidental finds were non-Singapore EU tenders, which look already covered by the EU TED work.
how_to_mine: Download the CSV from https://data.gov.sg/datasets/d_acde1106003906a75c3fa052592f2fcb/view. Filter the description for NovaSeq, Illumina, sequenc*, flow cell and reagent. Filter the supplier for Illumina Singapore, or for distributors such as Bio-Rad or Axil Scientific. Filter the agency for A*STAR, NUS, NUH, SingHealth, NCCS and Genome Institute of Singapore. Then list award dates and amounts, and check how many rows fall in 2023-24. If the file has only a few relevant rows, drop this source.
new_candidates: data.gov.sg GeBIZ historical awards CSV (d_acde1106003906a75c3fa052592f2fcb), a one-file download that can be filtered. It ends Mar 2024, so it covers only part of the window.
